topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture topic and sets expectations regarding complement's complexity.

topics.label: Core principles and central role of C3
topics.groupedBecause: They establish the fundamental architecture, nomenclature conventions, and central pivotal function of C3 in the complement cascade.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: They explain the mechanisms of the alternative, lectin, and classical pathways that trigger complement activation.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: They describe the three primary effector outcomes of complement activation: opsonization, inflammation, and membrane attack complex lysis.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement
topics.groupedBecause: It explains the molecular mechanisms and regulatory proteins that prevent host cell damage from complement activation.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: It outlines the distinct clinical presentations and disease manifestations associated with specific complement and regulatory protein deficiencies.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: It explores the molecular strategies used by pathogens such as Staphylococcus aureus to escape complement-mediated clearance.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: It provides concluding remarks and previews the upcoming lecture on adaptive immunity.
